source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the individual units tested.
3. Note the process (type of test and test parameter) and method used to record the pass/fail results. 
4. Describe the process.
5. List important variables that could affect results (if applicable) and those that may be held constant throughout the test series.
6. Review the test records to determine the pass/fail or critical results, including raw data, unit performance (or specification) range, media which may establish consensus on performance specifications (if applicable).  
7. Use the data analysed from test records to compose the report.  
8. The report must contain a table to record the pass/fail results (if applicable) of each individual unit tested and the overall pass/fail for the entire test series run at one time that documents the failed advertised specifications of the consumer product.
9. The report must clearly state the previous pass/fail result if the test series
